descricao_original: This electron micrograph shows a cross section through a portion of the wall of a kidney tubule whose cells possess microvilli. Large numbers of microvilli, as seen here, appear like a brush in the light microscope, hence the name brush border. Microvilli are non-motile and serve to increase surface area. 5000x
